description: Defines the DrmInfoEvent class used for DRM info event handling in Android, including constants for event types and methods for accessing event details.

classes.name: DrmInfoEvent
classes.description: Represents a DRM information event with type, message, and unique ID.

methods.name: DrmInfoEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DRM info event with unique ID, type, and message.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique session ID associated with the event.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of DRM event.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message associated with the event.
